attr.title: Prince of Persia Classic
attr.desc: The classic cinematic platform adventure, running from the player's own Android 1.0 game files on ARM Linux.
attr.inst: Copy the matching Prince of Persia Classic 1.0 APK and OBB into ports/popclassic/gamedata, then launch the port. The APK may keep its original filename; the OBB must be named main.1.org.ubisoft.premium.POPClassic.obb. The first launch imports the files on the handheld. No game data is included.
